## 目标

Shape & stride query methods: shape/strides/ndim/len/is_empty/offset/raw_dim/flags/storage_kind/access_semantics/data_location。
本任务将 SUMMARY.md 中的目标落实到 `src/tensor/impls.rs`，并与 `07-tensor §5, §6, §7, §8` 的 API、实现拆分和测试计划保持一致。

## 前置准备

- 确认 W6T5 已提供 layout flags 与 F-order stride 计算。
- 确认 W7 存储模块已提供 Owned/View/ViewMut/Arc 表示和 storage trait。
- 按 `07-tensor.md §5` 保持 tensor core 的最小职责。

## 实施步骤

### Step 1: 实现核心代码

在 `src/tensor/impls.rs` 中添加本任务要求的最小实现，保持职责边界与设计文档一致。

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DataLocation { Cpu }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum StorageKind { Owned, View, ViewMut, Arc }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AccessSemantics { ReadOnly, ReadWrite, SharedReadOnly }

impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: crate::storage::RawStorage,
    D: crate::dimension::Dimension,
{
    pub fn shape(&self) -> &[usize] { self.shape.slice() }
    pub fn strides(&self) -> &[isize] { self.strides.slice() }
    pub fn ndim(&self) -> usize { self.shape.ndim() }
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.shape.checked_size().expect("validated shape") }
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool { self.len() == 0 }
    pub fn offset(&self) -> usize { self.offset }
    pub fn flags(&self) -> crate::layout::LayoutFlags { self.flags }
    pub fn data_location(&self) -> DataLocation { DataLocation::Cpu }
}

impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: crate::storage::RawStorage,
    D: crate::dimension::Dimension + Clone,
{
    pub fn raw_dim(&self) -> D { self.shape.clone() }
}

// storage_kind() and access_semantics() dispatch via a single impl block
// that delegates to storage-type-specific associated constants defined in W7.
// Using separate impl blocks bound on StorageMut/StorageOwned/StorageShared/Storage<Elem>
// would cause coherence conflicts because Owned<A> and ViewMutRepr<A> each implement
// multiple marker traits leading to overlapping impls.
//
// Concrete mapping (enforced by W7 storage type definitions):
//   Owned<A>     → StorageKind::Owned,   AccessSemantics::ReadWrite
//   ViewRepr<A>  → StorageKind::View,    AccessSemantics::ReadOnly
//   ViewMutRepr  → StorageKind::ViewMut, AccessSemantics::ReadWrite
//   ArcRepr<A>   → StorageKind::Arc,     AccessSemantics::SharedReadOnly
impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: crate::storage::RawStorage,
    D: crate::dimension::Dimension,
{
    pub fn storage_kind(&self) -> StorageKind { S::STORAGE_KIND }
    pub fn access_semantics(&self) -> AccessSemantics { S::ACCESS_SEMANTICS }
}
```

### Step 2: 单元测试

> **强制要求**:
> - 本步骤必须包含一个或者多个单元测试。
> - 测试函数名称和测试内容必须参考对应设计文档的 **「测试计划」** 一节。
> - 编译检查与Lint检查不等同于单元测试。
> - 如果测试没有通过需要修复直至测试通过。
> - **无测试 = 任务未完成。**

测试依据: 验证 shape/strides/ndim/len/is_empty/offset/raw_dim/flags/storage_kind/access_semantics/data_location 全部查询方法。所有测试通过 `Owned::from_vec` + `new_unchecked` 自构造 storage，不依赖 W22 构造器。

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::dimension::Ix1;
    use crate::layout::{compute_f_strides, LayoutFlags};
    use crate::storage::Owned;

    /// Helper: construct an Owned<i32> tensor with F-contiguous layout.
    fn f_contig(data: Vec<i32>, shape: impl crate::dimension::Dimension)
        -> TensorBase<Owned<i32>, _>
    {
        let strides = compute_f_strides(&shape);
        let storage = unsafe { Owned::from_vec(data) };
        let flags = LayoutFlags::F_CONTIGUOUS;
        unsafe { TensorBase::new_unchecked(storage, shape, strides, 0, flags, false) }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tensor_shape_strides() {
        let tensor = f_contig(vec![1_i32; 12], [3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(tensor.shape(), &[3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(tensor.strides(), &[1, 3]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tensor_len_and_ndim() {
        let tensor = f_contig(vec![1_i32; 12], [3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(tensor.len(), 12);
        assert_eq!(tensor.ndim(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tensor_offset_and_flags() {
        let tensor = f_contig(vec![1_i32; 5], [5]);
        assert_eq!(tensor.offset(), 0);
        assert!(tensor.flags().is_f_contiguous());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tensor_raw_dim() {
        let tensor = f_contig(vec![1_i32; 4], [2, 2]);
        let dim = tensor.raw_dim();
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[2, 2]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tensor_is_empty() {
        let tensor = f_contig(Vec::<i32>::new(), [0, 3]);
        assert!(tensor.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tensor_data_location() {
        let tensor = f_contig(vec![1_i32], [1, 1]);
        assert_eq!(tensor.data_location(), DataLocation::Cpu);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tensor_storage_kind() {
        let tensor = f_contig(vec![1_i32; 4], [2, 2]);
        assert_eq!(tensor.storage_kind(), StorageKind::Owned);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_tensor_access_semantics() {
        let tensor = f_contig(vec![1_i32; 4], [2, 2]);
        assert_eq!(tensor.access_semantics(), AccessSemantics::ReadWrite);
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| shape()/strides() 返回 `&[usize]` / `&[isize]` 切片 | `07-tensor.md §5.4`：零拷贝查询，委托给 Dimension trait 的 `slice()` 方法 |
| `raw_dim()` 需要 `D: Clone` 单独 impl 块 | `07-tensor.md §5.4`：`Dimension` 不要求 `Clone`，单独实现避免对非 Clone 维度类型强加 bound |
| `storage_kind()`/`access_semantics()` 通过 `S::STORAGE_KIND`/`S::ACCESS_SEMANTICS` 关联常量分发 | 避免多 impl 块重叠冲突——所有存储类型统一走 `RawStorage` trait 的关联常量 |
| `data_location()` 硬编码返回 `Cpu` | `07-tensor.md §1.2` 当前仅支持 CPU；GPU 扩展时改为委托 storage trait |

## 注意事项

- `len()` 依赖 `shape.checked_size()`，零维度 shape 返回 0 而非 panic。
- `offset` 是逻辑起点到 storage 起点的偏移量，由构造器维护。
- 测试使用 `Owned::from_vec` + `new_unchecked` 自构造，不依赖 W22 `from_shape_vec`。
